data.one_liner: Text that morphs letter by letter, outline into outline, and into icons.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets that smoothly morph text letter by letter between different styles, weights, sizes, fonts, words, or icons using OpenType outline data. At rest, it renders as native plain text.
use_when: You want smooth typographic transitions between different weights, fonts, or words.
You are building Hero animations where titles need to morph smoothly between screens.
You want text labels to morph into icons seamlessly.
avoid_when: You are using complex contextual script shapes like Arabic or Indic where letter morphing fails.
You rely heavily on fonts loaded dynamically at runtime that cannot be bundled in pubspec.yaml.
strengths: No crossfade or ghosting; outlines truly morph into each other.
Falls back to pixel-perfect plain text at the start and end of animations.
Supports iOS system fonts (SF Pro) without bundling font assets.
weaknesses: Requires font files to be bundled and readable in pubspec.yaml for custom fonts.
Does not support contextual shaping or ligatures out of the box.
data.setup_notes: Bundle the font files you want to morph between in pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedMorphText(
  'New Word',
  style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Fraunces', fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, fontSize: 52),
)
